text:
alex: Kicking off py/ts SDK canary publish 0.8.1-canary -> npm/pypi shadowing. deploybot triggered for 5% cohorts.

deploybot: publish succeeded for cohorts: canary-5% (us-east-1, eu-west-1). Telemetry: median latency 200ms, errors 0.3%. Rolling metrics collection live.

maria: heads up — I see a brief spike in api-gateway 502s correlated with SDK batching enabled in canary. Digging into logs.

kyle: confirmed. Embedding client calls show a burst of `KV cache miss` logs and increased queuing when batch size >= 8. 502s coming from the model gateway timeouts.

jen: FYI the changelog generator also failed to render the deprecation note for the old sync client. I need to patch the release-notes script before GA.

sam: proposal: pin GA until we verify batching path. If we can't get errors <0.5% and p50/p95 latency back to baseline within 10m, we rollback. Also we should prepare a hotfix release with a backcompat shim for sync client behavior.

alex: Agreed. Action items: 1) Hold final GA cut. 2) Create 0.8.1-hotfix branch with shim + changelog fix. 3) Pin GA tag to 0.8.0 for now. @deploybot please partial rollback cohorts where spike observed.

deploybot: rollback initiated for cohorts: us-east-1, eu-west-1 -> reverting to 0.8.0. Estimated completion: ~3m. Monitoring and alerting notified.

maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/sdks/pull/1234 — adds sync shim, toggles batching default to 4 for canary, and fixes changelog rendering. CI green on unit & integration suites.

kyle: after rollback p50/p95 are back to baseline. Will re-run the canary with reduced batching (max 4) once PR merges. If stable, we can promote a new `next` dist-tag and then GA. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

release-bot: NOTE: update release notes before final cut — include deprecation timeline for sync client and explicit migration snippet. Tagging @jen to follow up.
